queries: AI token spending plateau prices August September October 2026

sources_considered.why: Readable primary measurement distinguishes spending, volume, prices, and sample limitations.
Readable production index documents falling average prices and the role of model mix.
Search identified an August–September plateau analysis, but the reader returned HTTP 403 for both URL variants.
File exceeded the reader’s size limit.
Read successfully, but the extracted columns interleave text around the plateau claim. No reliable contiguous quotation of that claim was available.
Search lead reports later spending growth, but primary Ramp measurements were preferred; it was not used as outcome evidence.

evidence_items.locator: Summary; comparison dates in Tokenomics table
evidence_items.explanation: Ramp reports spending growth between the weeks ending September 25 and October 23, alongside lower blended prices. This qualifies the plateau assertion, but a selected customer sample and two individual weeks cannot establish the industry’s monthly trend.

metric_scope.company: AI providers used by Ramp Token Spend Management customers

evidence_items.explanation: The gateway sample supports a substantial decline in average prices. Its methodology estimates spending from list prices, and its discussion attributes part of the decline to adoption of cheaper models, so it does not independently prove industry-wide provider price cuts caused by competition.

metric_scope.company: AI providers accessed through Vercel AI Gateway

unresolved_gaps: No representative, stable-population monthly expenditure series covering August through October was obtained.
Weekly spending growth does not establish or disprove a sustained monthly plateau.
The evidence does not separate provider price cuts from changing model and token-type mix.
Direct evidence establishing competition’s contribution to the cuts is missing.
The claim supplies no accounting basis for its financial trend.
Ramp’s readable snapshot has no publication date; available_at records availability at the evaluation freeze. Vercel’s date is its latest dated September update.
